crossRefs.note: Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.
For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.
For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.
For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy…
I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”
to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,
For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

translations.web: Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
translations.bsb: Your loving devotion, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds.
translations.kjv: Thy mercy, O LORD, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.
translations.asv: Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, is in the heavens; Thy faithfulness reacheth unto the skies.
